operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers everywhere: tables 'chip_model','screen_mode','phone'; columns 'Model_name','Launch_year','RAM_MiB','ROM_MiB','Slots','WiFi','Bluetooth','Graphics_mode','Char_cells','Pixels','Hardware_colours','used_kb','map','Type','Company_name','Hardware_Model_name','Accreditation_type','Accreditation_level','Date','chip_model','screen_mode' — must be double-quoted; column lookup case-insensitive.
Column named 'Date' is TEXT storing free text like 'Approved (awarded 15.11.12)' / 'Approved (valid until 14.09.13)' — declared type TEXT so dispatches to String, NOT Date fuzzer; no date parsing.
Column named 'Type' (TEXT) and 'map' (TEXT) are SQL-ish keywords; must be quoted in generated SQL.

FK child columns 'phone.chip_model' and 'phone.screen_mode' are TEXT while parent PKs 'chip_model.Model_name' (TEXT) and 'screen_mode.Graphics_mode' (REAL) — screen_mode FK is text-to-real affinity mismatch; sqlite will coerce on insert.
screen_mode.Graphics_mode is REAL PK with values 0.0..6.0; phone.screen_mode stores '1','3','4','5','6' as text — FK values are stringified reals.

chip_model.Model_name PK is TEXT with spaces ('X3 Advanced','X30 high-end'); phone.chip_model values ('X5','X51v','X3i') are NOT all present in parent (X5,X51v,X3i missing from chip_model samples) — FK integrity may be partial in original.
All columns notnull=0, no CHECK, no UNIQUE beyond PKs; small tables (14/7/8 rows) so original_values sampling k=min(5,len) is dense.
PKs are single-column TEXT/REAL; no composite keys, no self-FKs, no dangling FKs (both parents exist).
REAL columns hold integral floats (2002.0, 32.0) — Number fuzzer with scale from 'real' (no args) will produce wide-range floats, not these.
TEXT columns contain unicode '×' (Char_cells '80 × 32', Pixels '640 × 256') and en-dash '–' (map '3000–7FFF') — String CHARSET a-zA-Z 0-9() will not reproduce these.
Tiny DB: read_schema max_rows_per_table irrelevant; original_sizes 14/7/8.
No views/triggers/indexes beyond PKs in DDL.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer for Model_name, Company_name, Hardware_Model_name, Accreditation_*, Date, chip_model, screen_mode, Char_cells, Pixels, map, Type, Slots, WiFi, Bluetooth — random a-zA-Z0-9() strings with contamination; will not match 'Approved (awarded 15.11.12)' or '80 × 32' shapes.

Number fuzzer for Launch_year, RAM_MiB, ROM_MiB, Hardware_colours, used_kb, Graphics_mode — 'real' with no (a,b) args gives scale=0 default, range [-1,1] plus perturbation; original values 2002, 32, 64, 0..6 are far outside → implausible values, likely FN on range predicates (Launch_year>2000, RAM_MiB>=64).

screen_mode.Graphics_mode is REAL PK: Number fuzzer with single-column PK → max_l0=inf, fresh draws dominate; values will be floats in [-1,1] not 0..6, so phone.screen_mode FK draws from these floats stringified — joins still work but predicates like screen_mode='1' fail.

phone.screen_mode FK draws from parent's FINAL Graphics_mode values (floats) with replacement → text '0.37...' etc.; original '1','3' not reproduced → FP risk on equality joins if gold expects specific modes.

chip_model.Model_name PK String with max_l0=inf → fresh random strings; phone.chip_model FK draws from these → join works but 'X3 Advanced' style values lost → FN on LIKE '%Advanced%' or equality to specific model.
String fuzzer adds str(i±1) for int-like elements; '1','3','4' in phone.screen_mode may get '2','0','5' neighbors — partial tie preservation.
Number fuzzer list-range quirk (upper end overwritten to full range) means even with elements [2002..2005], fresh draws span [-1,1] — Launch_year predicates on 2002-2005 mostly miss.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement in Python; all rows insert (no constraint failures expected) since notnull=0 everywhere.
PK dedup: single-column PKs with max_l0=inf → few duplicates; drop_unique_duplicates no-op (no unique non-PK columns).
Date column is TEXT → String fuzzer, no date template; gold SQL likely uses LIKE 'Approved%' or substr — random strings break these → FN.
Small tables (14/7/8) mean choose_table_sizes level-0 = 1+30*u ≈ 1..31 rows; parent tables may be smaller than child phone (8) → FK draws with replacement from few values, ties likely.
Bool/Bit/Time/Date fuzzers unused (no bool/bit/year/time/date/timestamp declared types).
